name: VERTIGO OS
description: Operate VERTIGO META OS or your Personal SALES OS from an ordinary ChatGPT chat. Notion stays the durable truth; physical Notion writes go through your native Notion app; every durable change is independently verified; automated emails execute only through the deterministic Mail Executor.

transports.http: remote MCP endpoint POST /mcp (HARNESS_TRANSPORT=http, bearer token → principal via HARNESS_HTTP_TOKENS_FILE)

harness.side_effects: backend transaction mechanics only (bindings, plans, receipts, leases in the harness store); no Notion write, no email
harness.caller_authority_inputs: none — roots, runtime ids, owners, gates, versions, verdicts and baselines are backend-derived

native_notion_app.role: performs every physical Notion write (stage-1, finalization, State/Manifest LAST) exactly as rendered by os_prepare
permissions: read pages and databases of the bound runtime
create pages in the runtime control-plane databases

native_gmail.role: competent source for mailbox/thread/effect reality (read/reconcile); native send only inside the owner-approved EXTERNAL_ACTION_TEST scope or by a human in DRAFT_THEN_HUMAN_SEND
permissions: read mail / search sent and threads
send mail (approved test scope / human-performed only)

mail_executor.inputs: immutable references only; recipient, content, mode and overrides are refused
mail_executor.credential: MAIL_EXECUTOR_GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the executor environment only

safe_fallbacks.no_native_notion: read-only: os_bind, os_resume, os_handoff, os_control_status; no durable change is claimed
safe_fallbacks.no_gmail: no send, no replay, no completion of an unresolved email intent; internal Notion planning may continue if safe
safe_fallbacks.no_notion: no automated send whose authority/intent/safety state depends on durable state; Gmail may be inspected for recovery evidence only
